raw_output:
alias: 晚上七点后玄关有人且客厅窗户关闭时触发
description: 晚上七点后，如果玄关检测到有人，并且客厅窗户关闭，那么打开客厅灯并将空调设为22度。
mode: single
triggers:
  - platform: time
    at: '19:00:00'
  - platform: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hall_motion
    to: 'on'
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.living_window
    state: 'off'
actions:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_main
  - service: climate.set_temperature
    data:
      temperature: 22
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_ac
